name: 无限能源
prompt: Create ONE five-style comparison sheet for ONE new game achievement emblem. The three supplied sheets are AUTHORITATIVE confirmed drawing-style references; match their five corresponding panels exactly in abstraction, stroke scale, detail density and edge quality. Do not copy their wolf, doorway or book subjects. Landscape, FIVE equal panels in ONE horizontal row, plain pale warm-gray background, small numbers 01–05 below their matching panels, no other text. Only the thematic subject, no medal frame, ribbon, mounting plate, wreath or pedestal. Show the SAME integrated abstract subject in each of the FIVE distinct styles: 01 coarse matte anime card-art paint, large connected opaque ivory and blue-gray masses, very few wide blunt directional strokes, handmade edges, grouped hard shadows, quiet areas, a small restrained identity-color accent. NO generic glossy fantasy inventory-item rendering. 02 radically simplified three to five flowing charcoal/ivory/cobalt brush gestures, generous negative space, strongly abstract, only the essential identity shapes. 03 black sumi-e calligraphy, two to five broad gestural ink shapes, generous negative space, expressive dry-brush endings, tiny vermilion accent, no gray shaded realistic object. 04 five to seven broad overlapping torn-paper shapes in coral/ochre/cream/navy and restrained identity accent, matte flat layering, no painted shading. 05 clean solid midnight-blue negative-space sign with generous cutouts, ingenious minimal curved and angular shape balance, one tiny blue accent, no texture. Keep complete emblems INSIDE their cells with clear generous margin and consistent visual size. No glow, particles, microdetail, realistic materials, tiny fur, fine lines, smooth 3D or environmental scenes. Intended as theme-only achievement art; give the subject intentional rhythm and one unified visual idea. Achievement: 无限能源. Meaning: 一回合打出至少10张招式. Shared abstract visual concept: ONE bold angular lightning stroke loops back into itself as an unfinished infinity gesture, with a clear open center. The lightning and flowing loop are one integrated sign. No glowing orb or electricity particles.
